metadata.summary: Reviews PRs, comments inline, flags risky changes.

steps: Read the pull request and its diff
Flagged one risky change in the cache invalidation path
Left inline comments on the three files it touched
example.reply: Reviewed — the change looks sound apart from the invalidation path, where a stale entry can survive a revision bump. I've commented inline and summarised on the PR.

steps: Fetched merged PRs since the last run

steps: Pulled the failing workflow run's logs

example.reply: The run failed in the migration step, not the tests — one migration expects a column the previous one hasn't added yet. I've pinged the commit author with the log excerpt.
